beginner.purpose: Used to import catalog item details directly from spreadsheet sheets.
beginner.how_to_use: Select/Paste spreadsheet cells containing headers and rows, then validate and click submit.
beginner.example: Importing 100 new styles of footwear with planned MRP and costs.

power_user.validation: Validates size run curve consistency and verifies that brand and categories exist in SMRITI masters.
power_user.workflow: Draft -> Row-by-Row Validation -> Bulk Insertion -> Stock Master Registry

developer.manual_reference: Volume 2 > Master Data > Item Import Services

beginner.purpose: Used by cashiers to record counter sales, process payments, and print customer bills.
beginner.how_to_use: Add items via barcode search or manual lookup, input customer details, select payment method, and complete sale.
beginner.example: Billing 2 pairs of sports shoes with a 10% promotional discount.

power_user.validation: Checks stock availability in the active POS store warehouse, applies active promotions, and calculates taxes.
power_user.workflow: Scan -> Price Apply -> Payment Capture -> Invoice Insertion -> Receipt Print

beginner.purpose: Used to raise formal purchase requests to suppliers for inventory procurement.
beginner.how_to_use: Select supplier, add items with style codes, purchase prices, quantities, and submit for approval.
beginner.example: Ordering 500 units of Autumn apparel from active supplier AITDL Supplier.

power_user.validation: Validates prices against supplier price lists and ensures total quantity satisfies vendor minimum order quantities (MOQ).
power_user.workflow: Reorder Suggestion -> Draft PO -> Vendor Alignment -> Management Approval -> Submission

beginner.purpose: Used for recording stock transfers, warehouse adjustments, and physical count reconciliations.
beginner.how_to_use: Select entry type (Material Transfer/Issue), source & target warehouses, add items, and log quantities.
beginner.example: Transferring 50 pairs of shoes from Main Warehouse to Counter A.

power_user.validation: Checks stock levels at source warehouse and logs entries dynamically to ERPNext Stock Ledger without bypassing tax controls.
power_user.workflow: Request -> Verification -> Transfer Entry -> Target Receipt confirmation
